segments.name: U.S. Consumer Services
segments.description: Provides credit, charge and complementary financial products and services to U.S. consumers.
segments.evidence: We principally engage in businesses comprising four reportable operating segments: U.S. Consumer Services (USCS), Commercial Services (CS), International Card Services (ICS) and Global Merchant and Network Services (GMNS).

segments.name: Commercial Services
segments.description: Offers credit, charge cards and payment solutions to small businesses, mid-sized companies and large corporations.
segments.evidence: We principally engage in businesses comprising four reportable operating segments: U.S. Consumer Services (USCS), Commercial Services (CS), International Card Services (ICS) and Global Merchant and Network Services (GMNS).

segments.name: International Card Services
segments.description: Provides credit, charge cards and related products and services to customers outside the United States.
segments.evidence: We principally engage in businesses comprising four reportable operating segments: U.S. Consumer Services (USCS), Commercial Services (CS), International Card Services (ICS) and Global Merchant and Network Services (GMNS).

segments.name: Global Merchant and Network Services
segments.description: Manages merchant relationships worldwide, operates the payments network and provides merchant services and solutions.
segments.evidence: Our GMNS reportable operating segment builds and manages relationships with millions of merchants around the world that choose to accept American Express cards.

revenueModel.text: Card Members and commercial customers pay annual fees and interest on card balances; merchants pay discount rates for card acceptance; third-party issuers and acquirers pay network fees.
revenueModel.evidence: The Delta cobrand portfolio generates fee revenue and interest income from Card Members and discount revenue from Delta and other merchants for spending on Delta cobrand cards.
